user.title: CTHA - Chronothermostat
user.description: Pick the thermostat that runs the zone: CTHA will schedule its setpoint. Control itself stays with the thermostat.

abort.already_configured: A zone already exists for this thermostat.

set_override.name: Set override
set_override.description: Force a temperature on a zone, bypassing the schedule.

temperature.name: Temperature
temperature.description: Temperature to hold while the override lasts.

policy.name: Expiry
policy.description: When the override lapses: end of the current half-hour, level change, fixed duration, scenario change, or never. Overrides born from a hand on the thermostat use «level change».

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Override duration, used only with the fixed-duration expiry.

clear_override.name: Clear override
clear_override.description: Remove a zone's override and put it back on the schedule.

apply.name: Rewrite setpoints
apply.description: Put the zones back on the setpoint they should hold, right away, without waiting for the watchdog. Useful after a zone becomes reachable again, or to see the effect of a change without waiting.

zone_id.name: Zone
zone_id.description: Zone to rewrite. If omitted every zone is rewritten, staggered so as not to saturate the bus.

set_level.name: Set temperature level
set_level.description: Create a temperature level or update its name, colour and global setpoint. Levels are open-ended: high, medium, low and antifreeze are only the initial ones.

level.name: Level
level.description: Level id: it is created if it does not exist.

color.name: Colour
color.description: Colour the level is drawn with in the grid, as a CSS value.

char.name: Character
char.description: Character standing for the level inside day templates. It can only be given at creation: changing it later would mean rewriting every day template using it.

temperature.name: Global setpoint
temperature.description: Temperature of the level at the root of the hierarchy. If omitted at creation the level starts at 20 °C.

delete_level.name: Delete temperature level
delete_level.description: Delete a level and every setpoint referring to it. Fails if the level is still painted in a day template.

level.name: Level
level.description: Id of the level to delete.

set_setpoint.name: Set setpoint
set_setpoint.description: Write a level's temperature at one point of the hierarchy: global, scenario, zone, week template or day template. The lower one wins; whoever says nothing inherits.

temperature.name: Temperature
temperature.description: Temperature of the level. Leaving it empty makes that point inherit again; the global setpoint cannot be empty.

scenario_id.name: Scenario
scenario_id.description: Writes the setpoint on the given scenario.

zone_id.name: Zone
zone_id.description: Writes the setpoint on the given zone.

week_template.name: Week template
week_template.description: Writes the setpoint on the given week template.

day_template.name: Day template
day_template.description: Writes the setpoint on the given day template.

set_day_template.name: Set day template
set_day_template.description: Create a day template or update its name and slots. Omitted fields are left alone.

template_id.name: Identifier
template_id.description: Day template id: it is created if it does not exist.

slots.name: Slots
slots.description: 48 characters, one every 30 minutes from midnight. Each temperature level has its own character; "-" inherits, that is, imposes nothing.

paint_slots.name: Paint slots
paint_slots.description: Assign a level to a range of slots of a day template, both ends included.

template_id.name: Day template
template_id.description: Id of the day template to change.

start_slot.name: First slot
start_slot.description: First slot to paint: 0 is midnight, 47 is 23:30.

end_slot.name: Last slot
end_slot.description: Last slot to paint, included. If omitted only the first slot is painted.

level.name: Level
level.description: Level to assign. If omitted the slots go back to inheriting.

duplicate_day_template.name: Duplicate day template
duplicate_day_template.description: Copy a day template and, on request, attach the given days to the copy: it is how one day is made different without changing the template for everyone using it.

template_id.name: Day template
template_id.description: Id of the day template to copy.

new_id.name: Copy id
new_id.description: Id for the copy. If omitted one is generated.

name.name: Copy name
name.description: Name of the copy. If omitted the original's name is used with "(copia)" appended.

week_template.name: Week template
week_template.description: Week in which to re-attach the days to the copy. If omitted the copy stays unattached.

days.name: Days
days.description: Days to re-attach, with 0 = Monday. If omitted every day of that week using the original is moved.

delete_day_template.name: Delete day template
delete_day_template.description: Delete a day template. Fails if a week template is still using it.

template_id.name: Day template
template_id.description: Id of the day template to delete.

set_week_template.name: Set week template
set_week_template.description: Create a week template or update its name and assignments. The given days are merged with the existing ones.

template_id.name: Identifier
template_id.description: Week template id: it is created if it does not exist.

days.name: Days
days.description: Map day → day template, with 0 = Monday. An empty value leaves the day uncovered.

delete_week_template.name: Delete week template
delete_week_template.description: Delete a week template. Fails if a scenario is still assigning it to a zone.

template_id.name: Week template
template_id.description: Id of the week template to delete.

set_scenario.name: Set scenario
set_scenario.description: Create a scenario or update its name and zone configuration. A scenario is the map zone → week template; a new one starts from the active scenario's configuration.

scenario_id.name: Identifier
scenario_id.description: Scenario id: it is created if it does not exist.

zones.name: Zones
zones.description: Map zone → week template. An empty value takes the zone out of the scenario, leaving it unscheduled there.

delete_scenario.name: Delete scenario
delete_scenario.description: Delete a scenario. Neither the active one nor the last remaining one can be deleted.

scenario_id.name: Scenario
scenario_id.description: Id of the scenario to delete.

activate_scenario.name: Activate scenario
activate_scenario.description: Make a scenario active; overrides tied to the previous one lapse.

scenario_id.name: Scenario
scenario_id.description: Id of the scenario to activate.

set_zone_week_template.name: Zone schedule
set_zone_week_template.description: Assign the week template a zone follows inside a scenario.

template_id.name: Week template
template_id.description: Week template to assign. If omitted the zone leaves that scenario's schedule.

scenario_id.name: Scenario
scenario_id.description: Scenario the assignment belongs to. If omitted the active scenario is used.
